records.title: Material Footprint For All Products, Annual
records.dataSource: UNITED NATIONS ENVIRONMENT PROGRAMME SDG DATA HUB
records.footnote: Data are taken from United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)'s SDG Data Hub (https://sdgs.unep.org/sdg-data/). Data are used for SDG 8.4.1/12.2.1 'Material footprint, material footprint per capita, and material footprint per GDP'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 8.4.1/12.2.1.

row.footnote: Material footprint is the attribution of global material extraction to domestic final demand of a country and is based on four material types, namely biomass, fossil fuels, metal ores, and non-metallic minerals.

row.uoM: Kilograms Per Constant 2015 United States Dollars
